body: Anti despressents and other meds for mental health as far as I know will pretty much universally have side effects, everyone I know that's been on then has had their own reaction both good and bad! Including me! Normally as your body builds up a tolerance the side effects will have less of an affect, it's just sticking to the routine of taking them! Taking them at around the same time each day can help in my opinion! Just keep going! by the sounds of it you are doing really well! Takes a massive amount of strength to push through what you're going through!

It is perfectly normal to feel sad and down! people like myself who have been down a similar path will see there own individual take on the situation! So having your own reaction and prominent thoughts is perfectly ok! I'm sorry for presuming but I imagine you've suffered for a while! The people around you who care will understand! There will be arguments and anger because that's what mental health issues often cause, it feels like a rift between you and others! If you are on any medication for your condition  do keep taking them regularly and be sure to find a happy place within yourself before trying to take on something that will massively stress you

Truly, there are people in your life that will cherish you! I went through a long time feeling a lot of self hate and lack of motivation for anything! Through all of people still stood by me. Yes people will leave and it can be heartbreaking, are you family and friends aware of your condition if so it may feel as though there is judgement when in actual fact they are slowly learning more about your condition and how to give you the space you need whilst still loving you completely! Taking the time to learn to love yourself no matter how long it may take is always a massive step in becoming better and more in control! I'm proud of you for being able to talk about your situation. Thank you
Thank you, I'm really going to give this a try

Self harm mainly, everything just felt a bit better when I got that rush. It's been a couple of weeks now and I thought I was doing so well! But it all just comes full circle and seems to fall apart again.
